subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a public default config surface for embedded compaction while Codex native compaction only warns and ignores it?
rationale: Repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces, and the desired scope relative to broader per-agent compaction work is a product decision rather than a mechanical code fix.

options.title: Accept the narrow default option
options.body: Merge this focused config surface for embedded compaction after the normal branch refresh, leaving Codex-native behavior as an explicit warning-only no-op.

options.title: Fold into per-agent compaction work
options.body: Hold this PR and make thinking-level overrides part of the broader per-agent compaction contract instead of adding another defaults-only knob now.

options.title: Keep session thinking only
options.body: Reject the new config surface and keep compaction tied to the active session thinking level until a stronger product need appears.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow default option
recommendation.body: Merge this focused config surface for embedded compaction after the normal branch refresh, leaving Codex-native behavior as an explicit warning-only no-op.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest current-main ownership and adjacent thinking/config history point to steipete as the best available reviewer for this config contract choice.
